versions.version: System.Text.Encoding.CodePages dependency removed. Image transparency fixes (PNG alpha/color detection), validated color masks, reusable stencil masks, new HpdfImage.SetSoftMask. PDF version is raised automatically for transparency (1.4). Color masks work on gray images; a PNG is read from the current stream position. AcroForms: checkboxes, radio buttons and signature fields draw their own frame (colors from SetAppearanceCharacteristics), the appearance state always follows the field value, /SigFlags is set for signature fields; text and choice fields get appearance streams showing their values and the form gets default resources (/DR). New: HpdfPageText.TextRect, HpdfPage.Rotate, HpdfCatalog.ViewerPreferences and SetOpenAction, EoFillStroke/ClosePathEoFillStroke, SetFlat. Fixed: text measurement treated Unicode characters such as U+010A as line breaks; the text line position ignored the text matrix scale; a document could not be saved twice; non-ASCII text (field names, values and options, outline titles, document information) was written as UTF-8 and is now a PDF text string (UTF-16BE); with RC4 encryption only the first string of an object (e.g. of the document information) could be decrypted; non-ASCII link URIs are percent-encoded; Arc continues a path that is being built with a line (pie slices); outline /Count of closed nested items; TextRect honors horizontal scaling; setters such as SetBorderStyle, SetRgbColor, SetSlideShow, SetDestination can be called again; the compression mode applies to pages added before it was set; image masks and page labels raise the PDF version to 1.3; JPEG images are read from the current stream position. Validation as in the C library: GSave/GRestore nesting, invalid line cap/join/rendering mode, all-zero dash patterns, text without a font, equal arc angles, unsupported encryption modes, raw image bit depths, duplicate page resource names, widget colors, radio option names, choice values. Breaking: IElementAppearance has new members Caption and DrawFrame; IDrawable has the new member PathInProgress; Haru.Forms.HpdfTextAlignment is renamed to HpdfFieldAlignment (Haru.Types.HpdfTextAlignment is used by TextRect); HpdfString(string) writes a PDF text string instead of UTF-8; ShowText and related methods throw PageFontNotFound without a font; HpdfAcroForm has no public constructor (use GetOrCreateAcroForm); the duplicate extension method HpdfDocumentExtensions.LoadPngImageFromFile is removed; radio button groups accept only option widgets; HpdfSignature.SetValue/SetDefaultValue throw; SetEncryption requires an owner password that is not empty and differs from the user password (as in the C library) and accepts only Latin-1 passwords; the HpdfLinkAnnotation and HpdfTextAnnotation constructors are internal (use HpdfPage.CreateLinkAnnotation / CreateTextAnnotation, new overload with HpdfDestination); outline and link destinations need a view. Also: PDF/A sets the Print flag on annotations; PNG images load from forward-only streams.
Feature: Identity-H Unicode support in HpdfCIDFont. The skill for nuget-skills added.
Fully C# version of Haru PDF library.
